description: Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.1 firmware with Halo/Keymind retry tuning, Cascade defaults, and the USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / SF7 / BW62.5 / CR5 preset. This catalog contains standard builds, Full Companion builds, compact LoRa-OTA builds, and portable MQTT observer builds with USB debug/packet logging off. On nRF52, Full Companion replaces separate BLE and USB choices; on ESP32, Full Companion is offered next to the BLE/USB variants. Open Release notes for role, hardware, installation, and partition requirements.

companionWifi.name: Companion WiFi
companionWifi.description: Companion radio over trusted local Wi-Fi (TCP port 5000). First-time network setup uses the MeshCore setup access point; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: Telemetry node that reads and publishes only the sensors compiled for and detected on the selected board; this custom role is not a companion or repeater.

terminalChat.name: Terminal Chat
terminalChat.description: Standalone text-chat client operated from a serial terminal; it does not expose the normal companion-app interface and may not map to the standard Configure step.

companionEthernet.name: Companion Ethernet
companionEthernet.description: Companion radio over wired Ethernet (TCP port 5000). Requires compatible Ethernet hardware and a DHCP network; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

companionFull.name: Full Companion
companionFull.description: Combined Companion build. nRF52 provides USB and BLE; ESP32 provides USB, BLE, Wi-Fi/WebConfig, host-backed mOTA seeding, and the OTA console. It can serve updates to other nodes but cannot LoRa-self-update; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

standard-v1.17.1.1-759a35fc.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.1 with Halo/Keymind retry tuning and Cascade defaults.

ROLE — Companion BLE: bridges a phone or desktop MeshCore companion app to LoRa over Bluetooth LE. Choose it when the app will connect directly by BLE.

PROFILE — Standard/utility: normal features for the selected role and hardware, with USB debug/packet logging and LoRa self-update OFF.

INSTALL — First-time setup uses Full install (the merged bootloader + firmware image). Routine upgrades use Update (the app-only image) and normally preserve settings. Enable Erase all flash only when you intentionally want a clean reset.

lora-ota-v1.17.1.1-759a35fc.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.1 with Halo/Keymind retry tuning and Cascade defaults.

ROLE — Companion USB: bridges a computer or host app to LoRa over USB serial. Choose it for a wired companion connection, not for an unattended repeater.

PROFILE — LoRa OTA companion: keeps the standard USB/Wi-Fi companion interface, adds LoRa OTA folder transport and self-update support, and keeps USB debug/packet logging OFF. This is not an expanded-partition FULL build.

INSTALL — First-time setup uses Full install (the merged bootloader + firmware image). Routine upgrades use Update (the app-only image) and normally preserve settings. Enable Erase all flash only when you intentionally want a clean reset.

LORA OTA — This page installs the base firmware, not a .mota package. Obtain and apply exact board-and-role .mota updates separately through the MeshCore LoRa OTA workflow; .mota files cannot be web flashed here.

SELECTION — OTA.

ROLE — Full Companion: combines USB and Bluetooth LE companion interfaces in one nRF52 image. USB starts in Binary Companion mode and can also provide the ASCII terminal or exclusive host-backed mOTA source mode.

PROFILE — Full Companion: can serve exact board-and-role host .mota images to other nodes over LoRa, but deliberately cannot stage or install a LoRa update for itself. USB debug/packet logging is OFF.

INSTALL — Browser flashing uses the Serial DFU .zip. The .uf2 is provided for manual drag-and-drop through a compatible UF2 bootloader volume. A normal firmware flash does not erase saved settings.

mqtt-observer-v1.17.1.1-759a35fc.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.1 with Halo/Keymind retry tuning, Cascade defaults, and the USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / SF7 / BW62.5 / CR5 preset.

ROLE - Repeater: always-on infrastructure that relays mesh traffic. Configure its name/location, radio settings, and admin password.

PROFILE - Portable MQTT observer: forwards mesh observations to an on-device Wi-Fi MQTT bridge, keeps USB debug/packet logging off, and uses bridge NTP instead of mesh clock consensus. LoRa self-update is off in this compact profile.

INSTALL - First-time setup uses Full install (the merged bootloader + firmware image). Routine upgrades use Update (the app-only image) only when the existing app partition is compatible.

PARTITION - This target fits its generated app partition but is larger than the legacy 1,310,720-byte portable app ceiling. If the device has an older or smaller partition table, flash the matching merged image once before using app-only updates.

NETWORK - Configure Wi-Fi and MQTT broker settings before relying on observer forwarding.

SELECTION - Portable MQTT observer.
